blind.B1: No. GSE250520 is an in-vitro human cardiac organoid series, vehicle vs IL-1beta (COVID cytokine-storm model; S2.1.p2, FIG2d). IL-1beta is not an exercise mediator. The only 'simulated exercise' is a norepinephrine stress test measuring beating rate (S2.6.p2, ABS), with no RNA-seq. No sequenced sample carries an exercise factor.
blind.B2: IL-1beta-treated hCOs vs control hCOs, n=3 vs 3 (S2.1.p2, FIG3b n=3).
blind.B3: No repeated measures: organoid pools from one hiPSC-CM donor line, one time point (D4). The title suffix key (Vehicle.1 vs IL1bOrgs.1) is only a replicate index; expression check not supported (r=-0.47 vs 0.25).
blind.B4: The paper does not say how the RNA-seq DEGs were fitted (S5 gives only Prism t-test/ANOVA rules; FIG3c uses median of ratios).
blind.B5: No RNA-seq DEG rule or DEG count is stated. S5.p2 gives only 'p < 0.05' for t-tests/ANOVA on non-omics assays.

checks.evidence: Refusal matches B1: in-vitro IL-1beta vs vehicle, no exercise arm; the NE stress test has no transcriptome (S2.6.p2). Not an exercise-mediator design.
Not run; the 3 vs 3 split (VEH/IL1B) matches the paper n=3.
No repeated unit; title-suffix key is a replicate index and expression check is not_supported. Not a stop reason here.
Single donor line, single time point, one treatment factor; nothing to alias.
Raw counts (integer_fraction 1.0, STAR+htseq). Handback notes a stray second header row to drop if ever used; does not affect the refusal.
Recorded as 'not stated', which is true (S5.p2 is a generic t-test rule).
No numbers compared; HANDBACK claims none.
The reason (no exercise arm / NE assay not sequenced) is true and was checked against the paper text, metadata and matrix columns.

summary: 拒绝分析是正确的:GSE250520 只有体外心脏类器官的 IL-1β 与溶媒对照(各3个),没有运动组,论文中的“模拟运动”是只测搏动率的去甲肾上腺素实验,没有转录组。配对、阈值、矩阵记录均无问题,整体通过。
